scope: iCloud restored-photo replacement, native Windows execution, and USB exclusion ledger
sources_relied_upon: Configured update, iCloud Photos, backup, report, and USB-output directories
Native Windows PowerShell File Provider access rather than WSL access to iCloud
material_decisions: Restored updates are rendered and EXIF-verified outside iCloud before any native Windows action.
The generated PowerShell executor backs up, copies, verifies, and deletes exact-name originals by default; -SkipBackup and -SkipICloudHashVerification are explicit operator overrides.
A durable superseded-source ledger excludes verified replaced originals from future USB rebuilds even when iCloud rehydrates them locally.
Native Windows manifest paths are emitted in Windows format, never WSL /mnt paths.
validation_performed: Prepared 243 restored JPEGs and regenerated the native Windows CSV and PowerShell artifacts.
Confirmed generated PowerShell contains the optional backup and iCloud-hash skip switches.
open_questions: The native Windows replacement run is in progress; its live CSV report is the source of truth for remaining outcomes.
After the native run completes, seed the USB superseded-source ledger from its results before the next rebuild.
recommended_next_step: Allow the active native Windows run to complete, inspect its result CSV for failures, then run the native-results ledger seed command before rebuilding USB output.
